a.text: Before we start, I want to flag a problem with our agreement. With an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells takes at least 2 rounds of operating, so we each have only about a 4% chance of surviving if we follow it. Taking the 4 cells now would let one of us survive almost for sure. But if we both take, the random split could leave both of us short. I won't break our deal behind your back. I propose we openly agree who takes now. If you'd rather stick to the original plan, say so and I'll operate. Tell me your intended action.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: I'm operating this round as I promised, since your plan is the original one. Please read my opening note, though. With 80% storms, that plan gives us both very poor odds. If you're willing to change it, tell me, and we can agree openly who takes. Until then I'll stick to the agreement.
